Evidence you can follow

Every material conclusion should lead back to a proposal, transaction, dated capture or attributed statement.

Start with the underlying records

    A1–A289, captured 23 October 2026. Combines MB’s two board wallets and explains the A28/A29 correction.

How this briefing was prepared

This is a rewritten presentation of 0xphilipp Payments, whose page update is dated 25 October 2026. Its public pages and available linked evidence files were collected for this rebuild. The original compilation credits seven Terra validator operators.

The shorter account preserves the source’s accounting qualifications and distinguishes documented acts, interpretations and questions. Published source copies include privacy edits to labels; financial amounts and transaction references are retained. It does not constitute a new independent audit of every underlying transaction.

What the dates mean

Receipt coverage differs by category. The main register extends through 11 October with a targeted 17 October stewardship update; the retained-power count is checked through 18 October. Voting was captured on 23 October and separate technical roles on 24 October 2026.

Later changes may alter the current position. A saved proposal marked passed is not proof that its executable actions occurred; compare the contract state at the captured block.

What the figures mean

The receipt total combines project funding, compensation, gross fees, reimbursements and locked capital. It is not a personal net-profit statement. Historical valuations estimate receipt-time value, with missing prices excluded from the USD subtotal. Upstream grants and downstream distributions are not added twice.

Fee reconciliation · Complete valuation method · Published verification manifest

Editorial approach

We focus on documented decisions, procedures and evidence limits. The briefing does not judge personal character or invite action against anyone. Corrections and discussion should address specific records. Personal attacks, unwanted contact and harassment have no place here.

Giving feedback

When sharing a correction or question, include the page URL, the specific statement or amount, and a source supporting your point. Where possible, include the transaction hash, proposal identifier and capture date.

Share this early version with others to assess whether the account is clear, fair and sufficiently supported. No feedback form or account is required.
